CANON
In the story, the Six Paths of Pain are controlled from far away, and if the one controlling them is interrupted, all of them stop.
OUR RULE
In your version, that's the whole day. Keep the six moving, and don't let one fall.
CANON
Each body carries one Path. The Rinnegan shares what every body sees with the user.
CANON
In the story, Nagato's body was weak, and the six bodies did the walking for him.
OUR RULE
In your version, you keep your own face, and the weak body is yours. The six are hollow vessels. Nobody's inside them. Nobody's lost.
CANON
The Deva Path controls gravity. Shinra Tensei pushes everything away. Bansho Ten-in pulls it in.
CANON
After a Shinra Tensei, there's a cooldown. At least five seconds. During that time, the Deva Path can't use any of its other abilities either.
OUR RULE
In your version, you can't cheat the number. It's five. Every time. And everyone you're protecting has to survive those five seconds on their own.
OUR RULE
In your version, the bodies don't have faces of their own. They have yours, a little stretched, with orange hair you never chose.
OUR RULE
In your version, that's why you're here. Not a battle. A deadline.
CANON
The Animal Path summons creatures. You do it to carry sandbags up the face of the dam, one great animal at a time.
CANON
The Asura Path modifies the body with mechanical parts.
CANON
The Preta Path absorbs energy. In your version, it takes the force out of the river, so the wall doesn't have to.
CANON
In the story, the Human Path can pull a soul out of someone.
OUR RULE
In your version, you don't use that one. Not today. Not ever. You just keep it where you can see it.
CANON
In the story, the Naraka Path is the most valuable of the six. The others will sacrifice themselves to protect it.
OUR RULE
In your version, that's the rule you hate most. You have to decide which one is worth more. And it isn't the one you'd choose.
OUR GUESS
Our guess is that the real danger isn't any single push. It's the count between pushes, when everything you love is waiting.
CANON
In the story, if the controller is interrupted while sending chakra, every body stops and becomes vulnerable.
OUR RULE
In your version, that's all it takes. One touch. One shake. One raised voice.
